features.description: Your mystical connection to a chosen land (Arctic, Coast, Desert, Forest, Grassland, Mountain, Swamp, or Underdark) grants you access to an expanding list of spells that are always prepared and don't count against your prepared spells. Examples include Hold Person and Spike Growth for Arctic, or Mirror Image and Misty Step for Coast. Land’s Stride (6th Level): Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed or taking damage, and you have advantage on saving throws against magically manipulated plants. Nature’s Ward (10th Level): You can't be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and you are immune to poison and disease. Nature’s Sanctuary (14th Level): When a beast or plant creature attacks you, it must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, it must choose a different target or the attack automatically misses. On a success, the creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

name: Circle of the Moon
flavor_text: "Druids of the Circle of the Moon draw on lunar magic to transform themselves. Their order gathers under the moon to share news and perform rituals. Changeable as the moon, a Druid of this circle might prowl as a great cat one night, soar over the treetops as an eagle the next day, and then crash through undergrowth as a bear to drive off a trespassing monster. The wild is in the Druid’s blood."
description: The ultimate shapeshifter. You can use Wild Shape as a bonus action, transform into much more powerful beasts than other druids, and eventually assume elemental forms. You are a front-line combatant who tanks damage and adapts to any situation.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Combat Wild Shape (2nd Level)
features.description: You can use your Wild Shape as a bonus action. While in beast form, you can expend a spell slot as a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d8 per level of the spell slot expended (1d12 in the 2024 rules).

features.name: Circle Forms (2nd/3rd Level)
features.description: Your maximum Challenge Rating for Wild Shape forms equals your druid level divided by 3 (rounded down). While transformed, you can calculate your AC as 13 + your Wisdom modifier if that is higher than the beast's AC, and you gain temporary hit points equal to three times your druid level.

features.name: Circle of the Moon Spells (3rd Level)
features.description: You always have certain spells prepared (e.g., Cure Wounds, Moonbeam, Flaming Sphere) and can cast them while in Wild Shape form.

features.name: Improved Circle Forms (6th Level)
features.description: Your attacks in Wild Shape can deal radiant damage instead of their normal type, and you can add your Wisdom modifier to your Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration.

features.name: Moonlight Step (10th Level)
features.description: As a bonus action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, reappearing in a burst of moonlight. You can also teleport a willing creature of your choice within 5 feet of you.

features.name: Lunar Form (14th Level)
features.description: While in Wild Shape, you can expend two uses of Wild Shape at once to assume an elemental form (Air, Earth, Fire, or Water) with a Challenge Rating of 5.

name: Circle of the Shepherd
flavor_text: "Voices cry out from the wilderness, unheard by many but not by you. You know that animals play a vital role in the natural world and you defend them against the forces that might destroy them. But you do not stand alone in this duty. You share a magical connection, a kinship with the spirits of the beasts and the fey that watch over them. Aided by their gifts, you defend these creatures and their homes and turn hunters into the hunted."
description: A summoner druid who communes with the spirits of nature. You can summon spirit totems to buff your allies and summoned creatures, empower your summoned beasts to be more durable and magical, and eventually call forth a powerful guardian spirit.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Speech of the Woods (2nd Level)
features.description: You learn to speak, read, and write Sylvan. You also gain the ability to understand and be understood by beasts, effectively granting you a permanent Speak with Animals effect.

features.name: Spirit Totem (2nd Level)
features.description: As a bonus action, you can summon an incorporeal spirit totem within 60 feet, creating a 30-foot-radius aura. The totem lasts for 1 minute or until you are incapacitated. You choose the spirit:

features.name: Bear Spirit
features.description: Grants you and your allies temporary hit points equal to 5 + your druid level.

features.name: Hawk Spirit
features.description: You can use your reaction to grant an ally advantage on an attack roll against a creature in the aura.

features.name: Unicorn Spirit
features.description: You and your allies gain a bonus to Wisdom (Perception) checks, and any healing spell you cast also heals all creatures of your choice in the aura for an amount equal to your druid level.

features.name: Mighty Summoner (6th Level)
features.description: Any beast or fey you summon with a spell gains 2 extra hit points per Hit Die it possesses, and its natural weapon attacks count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

features.name: Guardian Spirit (10th Level)
features.description: When a beast or fey you summoned drops to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to have it drop to 1 hit point instead. You can also expend a use of Wild Shape to cast Conjure Animals without expending a spell slot.

features.name: Faithful Summons (14th Level)
features.description: If you are reduced to 0 hit points or are incapacitated against your will, you can immediately gain the benefits of Conjure Animals as if it were cast with a 9th-level spell slot. The creatures summoned are friendly to you and your allies, and they remain for 1 hour or until you dismiss them.

name: Circle of Spores
flavor_text: "Druids of the Circle of Spores find beauty in decay. They see within mold and other fungi the ability to transform lifeless material into abundant, albeit somewhat strange, life. Druids of this circle have a complex relationship with the undead. Unlike most other druids, they see nothing inherently wrong with undeath, which they consider to be a companion to life and death. But these druids believe that the natural cycle is healthiest when each segment of it is vibrant and changing. Undead that seek to replace all life with undeath, or that try to avoid passing to a final rest, violate the cycle and must be thwarted."
description: A unique druid that blends the cycle of life and death with fungal power. You wield a halo of poisonous spores, can enter a symbiotic state that empowers your melee attacks and grants temporary hit points, and can even animate corpses as fungal servants.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Circle Spells (2nd Level)
features.description: You learn the Chill Touch cantrip, which doesn't count against your cantrips known. You also gain a list of always-prepared spells at 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level (e.g., Blindness/Deafness, Gaseous Form, Contagion, Cloudkill).

features.name: Halo of Spores (2nd Level)
features.description: You are surrounded by invisible, harmless spores. When a creature you can see moves within 10 feet of you or starts its turn there, you can use your reaction to deal 1d4 poison damage to it. This damage increases to 2d4 at 6th level, 3d4 at 10th, and 4d4 at 14th.

features.name: Symbiotic Entity (2nd Level)
features.description: As an action, you can expend a use of Wild Shape to awaken your spores for 10 minutes, gaining 4 temporary hit points per druid level. While active, your Halo of Spores damage increases by 1d6, and your melee weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 poison damage.

features.name: Fungal Infestation (6th Level)
features.description: When a Small or Medium humanoid dies within 10 feet of you, you can use your reaction to raise it as a zombie with 1 hit point that obeys your commands for 1 hour.

features.name: Spreading Spores (10th Level)
features.description: As a bonus action while your Symbiotic Entity is active, you can hurl spores up to 30 feet away, creating a 10-foot cube of swirling spores that deals your Halo of Spores damage to creatures that enter or start their turn there.

features.name: Fungal Body (14th Level)
features.description: You gain immunity to being blinded, deafened, frightened, and poisoned. Additionally, any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.

name: Circle of Stars
flavor_text: "The Circle of the Stars has tracked heavenly patterns since time immemorial, discovering secrets hidden amid the constellations. By understanding these secrets, the Druids of this circle seek to harness the powers of the cosmos."
description: A cosmic druid who draws power from the constellations. Instead of Wild Shaping into beasts, you assume luminous Starry Forms (Archer, Chalice, or Dragon) that grant powerful offensive, healing, or utility benefits. You also gain a magical Star Map to enhance your spellcasting.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Star Map (3rd Level)
features.description: You possess a magical star chart that serves as a spellcasting focus. While holding it, you have the Guidance cantrip and Guiding Bolt spell prepared. You can cast Guiding Bolt without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

features.name: Starry Form (3rd Level)
features.description: As a bonus action, you can expend a use of Wild Shape to assume a Starry Form for 10 minutes. Your body becomes luminous, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius. You choose one of three constellations:

features.name: Archer
features.description: You can make a ranged spell attack as a bonus action, dealing radiant damage equal to 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Chalice
features.description: Whenever you cast a healing spell, you or another creature within 30 feet regains additional hit points equal to 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Dragon
features.description: When you make an Intelligence or Wisdom check or a concentration save, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

features.name: Cosmic Omen (6th Level)
features.description: When you finish a long rest, roll a d6. You can use your reaction to add or subtract that number from an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw made by a creature you can see within 30 feet. You regain the use of this feature on a short or long rest.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations (10th Level)
features.description: The bonuses of your Starry Form increase (Archer and Chalice become 2d8). While in your Dragon form, you gain a flying speed of 20 feet and can hover.

features.name: Full of Stars (14th Level)
features.description: While in your Starry Form, you become partially incorporeal, gaining resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

name: Circle of Wildfire
flavor_text: "Druids within the Circle of Wildfire understand that destruction is sometimes the precursor of creation, such as when a forest fire promotes later growth. These druids bond with a primal spirit that harbors both destructive and creative power, allowing them to create controlled flames that burn away one thing but give life to another."
description: A balanced druid who wields fire as a tool of both destruction and healing. You summon a Wildfire Spirit companion that fights alongside you and can teleport your allies, empower your fire and healing spells, and eventually cauterize wounds or even revive the dead with your flames.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Circle Spells (2nd Level)
features.description: You gain an expanded spell list tied to your bond with a wildfire spirit. These spells are always prepared and include offensive fire spells like Burning Hands and Flaming Sphere, as well as healing spells like Cure Wounds and Revivify.

features.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit (2nd Level)
features.description: As an action, you can expend a use of Wild Shape to summon a Wildfire Spirit in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. The spirit is friendly to you and your allies, acts on your initiative, and can be commanded with a bonus action. It can fly, is immune to fire damage, and has a ranged attack (Flame Seed) and a Fiery Teleportation ability that can transport you and your allies while dealing fire damage to enemies.

features.name: Enhanced Bond (6th Level)
features.description: Whenever you cast a spell that deals fire damage or restores hit points while your wildfire spirit is summoned, you can add a d8 to one roll of the spell. You can also choose to have ranged spells originate from either yourself or your wildfire spirit's space.

features.name: Cauterizing Flames (10th Level)
features.description: When a Small or larger creature dies within 30 feet of you or your wildfire spirit, you can create a spectral flame in its space for 1 minute. When another creature enters that space, you can use your reaction to either heal it or deal fire damage to it equal to 2d10 + your Wisdom modifier. You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Blazing Revival (14th Level)
features.description: If you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can instead drop to 1 hit point and cause your wildfire spirit to explode in a burst of healing flame. You and creatures of your choice within 30 feet of the spirit regain hit points equal to half your maximum hit points, and each creature of your choice within 30 feet of the spirit takes fire damage. The spirit then disappears.

name: Arcane Archer
flavor_text: "An Arcane Archer studies a unique elven method of archery that weaves magic into attacks to produce supernatural effects. Arcane Archers are some of the most elite warriors among the elves. They stand watch over the fringes of elven domains, keeping a keen eye out for trespassers and using magic-infused arrows to defeat monsters and invaders before they can reach elven settlements."
description: A ranged Fighter who imbues arrows with magical effects, choosing from a list of Arcane Shot options to control and devastate enemies at a distance.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Arcane Archer Lore (3rd Level)
features.description: Gain proficiency in Arcana or Nature, and learn the Prestidigitation or Druidcraft cantrip.

features.name: Arcane Shot (3rd Level)
features.description: Learn two Arcane Shot options. Once per turn when firing a shortbow or longbow, you can apply one option to the arrow. Uses equal your proficiency bonus, regained on a short or long rest. Save DC = 8 + proficiency + Intelligence modifier.

features.name: Magic Arrow (7th Level)
features.description: Arrows you fire count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

features.name: Curving Shot (7th Level)
features.description: When you miss with a magic arrow, you can use a bonus action to reroll the attack against a different target within 60 feet.

features.name: Ever-Ready Shot (15th Level)
features.description: If you roll initiative and have no uses of Arcane Shot remaining, you regain one use.

name: Banneret (Purple Dragon Knight)
flavor_text: "A banneret is a knight who inspires greatness in others by committing brave deeds in battle. The mere presence of one in a hamlet is enough to cause some orcs and bandits to seek easier prey. A lone banneret is a skilled warrior, but a banneret leading a band of allies can transform even the most poorly equipped militia into a ferocious war band."
description: A supportive Fighter who leads through deeds, using their presence to rally allies and share their own resilience.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Rallying Cry (3rd Level)
features.description: When you use Second Wind, choose up to three allies within 60 feet; each regains hit points equal to your fighter level.

features.name: Royal Envoy (7th Level)
features.description: Gain proficiency in Persuasion (expertise if already proficient). If already proficient, gain another skill from a short list.

features.name: Inspiring Surge (10th Level)
features.description: When you use Action Surge, one ally within 60 feet can make one weapon attack as a reaction. At 18th level, you can choose two allies.

features.name: Bulwark (15th Level)
features.description: When you use Indomitable to reroll an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma save, one ally within 60 feet who failed the same save can also reroll.

name: Battle Master
flavor_text: "Battle Masters are students of the art of battle, learning martial techniques passed down through generations. The most accomplished Battle Masters are well-rounded figures who combine their carefully honed combat skills with academic study in the fields of history, theory, and the arts."
description: A tactical Fighter who uses Superiority Dice to fuel a variety of combat maneuvers, controlling the battlefield and supporting allies.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Combat Superiority (3rd Level)
features.description: Learn three maneuvers. You have four Superiority Dice (d8s), regained on a short or long rest. Save DC = 8 + proficiency + Strength or Dexterity modifier. Gain additional maneuvers and dice at higher levels.

features.name: Student of War (3rd Level)
features.description: Gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools and one additional Fighter skill.

features.name: Know Your Enemy (7th Level)
features.description: As a bonus action, discern certain strengths and weaknesses of a creature within 30 feet.

features.name: Maneuvers (Examples)
features.description: Ambush, Bait and Switch, Commander's Strike, Disarming Attack, Distracting Strike, Evasive Footwork, Feinting Attack, Goading Attack, Lunging Attack, Maneuvering Attack, Menacing Attack, Precision Attack, Pushing Attack, Rally, Riposte, Sweeping Attack, Trip Attack.

name: Cavalier
flavor_text: (No standalone flavor paragraph in the source; the subclass embodies "the ideals of knighthood, loyalty, honor, and martial mastery from the saddle.")
description: A mounted warrior and defender who excels at protecting allies, controlling the battlefield, and punishing enemies who ignore their mark.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency (3rd Level)
features.description: Gain proficiency in Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion, or learn a language.

features.name: Born to the Saddle (3rd Level)
features.description: Advantage on saves to avoid falling off your mount; mount/dismount costs only 5 feet of movement.

features.name: Unwavering Mark (3rd Level)
features.description: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can mark it. While marked, it has disadvantage on attacks against others, and if it damages another, you can make a special bonus-action attack against it with extra damage equal to half your fighter level.

features.name: Warding Maneuver (7th Level)
features.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet is hit, use your reaction to add 1d8 to the target's AC; if the attack still hits, the target has resistance to the damage.

features.name: Hold the Line (10th Level)
features.description: Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you when they move 5 feet or more within your reach; a hit reduces their speed to 0.

features.name: Ferocious Charger (15th Level)
features.description: If you move 10 feet straight before hitting a creature, it must succeed on a Strength save or be knocked prone (once per turn).

features.name: Vigilant Defender (18th Level)
features.description: Gain a special reaction usable on every creature's turn (except yours) solely for opportunity attacks.

name: Champion
flavor_text: "The archetypal Champion focuses on the development of raw physical power honed to deadly perfection. Those who model themselves on this archetype combine rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows."
description: A straightforward, powerful Fighter who excels at critical hits and physical resilience, requiring minimal management.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Improved Critical (3rd Level)
features.description: Weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete (7th Level)
features.description: Add half proficiency bonus (rounded up) to Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution checks that don't already use proficiency. Running long jump distance increases by Strength modifier.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style (10th Level)
features.description: Choose a second Fighting Style.

features.name: Superior Critical (15th Level)
features.description: Weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18–20.

features.name: Survivor (18th Level)
features.description: At the start of each turn, if you have no more than half your hit points left, regain 5 + Constitution modifier hit points.

name: Echo Knight
flavor_text: "The Echo Knight has mastered the art of using dunamis to summon the fading shades of unrealized timelines to aid them in battle. Surrounded by echoes of their own might, they charge into the fray as a cycling swarm of shadows and strikes."
description: A time-bending Fighter who manifests a translucent echo of themselves to attack from multiple positions and control space.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material (this subclass originates from Explorer's Guide to Wildemount).

features.name: Manifest Echo (3rd Level)
features.description: As a bonus action, manifest an echo within 15 feet. It has AC 14 + proficiency, 1 HP, and immunity to all conditions. You can command it to move 30 feet, swap places with it (costing 15 feet of movement), originate attacks from its space, and make opportunity attacks from its space.

features.name: Unleash Incarnation (3rd Level)
features.description: When you take the Attack action, you can make one additional melee attack from the echo's position. Uses equal to Constitution modifier (minimum 1), regained on a long rest.

features.name: Echo Avatar (7th Level)
features.description: You can temporarily transfer your consciousness to your echo, seeing and hearing through it, and it can move up to 1,000 feet away from you.

name: Eldritch Knight
flavor_text: "Eldritch Knights combine the martial mastery common to all Fighters with a careful study of magic. Their spells both complement and extend their combat skills, providing additional protection to shore up their armor and also allowing them to engage many foes at once with explosive magic."
description: A Fighter who blends weapon mastery with Wizard spellcasting, using magic for defense and area control.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Spellcasting (3rd Level)
features.description: Learn two Wizard cantrips and three 1st-level Wizard spells. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability. Spell slots progress as shown on the Eldritch Knight table.

features.name: Weapon Bond (3rd Level)
features.description: Bond with up to two weapons, summoning them as a bonus action.

features.name: War Magic (7th Level)
features.description: When you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

features.name: Eldritch Strike (10th Level)
features.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, it has disadvantage on its next save against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Charge (15th Level)
features.description: When you use Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 feet before the additional action.

features.name: Improved War Magic (18th Level)
features.description: When you cast a spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

name: Psi Warrior
flavor_text: "Psi Warriors awaken the power of their minds to augment their physical might. They harness this psionic power to infuse their weapon strikes, lash out with telekinetic energy, and create barriers of mental force."
description: A Fighter who uses Psionic Energy Dice to fuel telekinetic and defensive powers, blending martial prowess with mental might.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Psionic Power (3rd Level)
features.description: Gain Psionic Energy Dice (d6s, increasing in size and number with level). Regain one on a short rest, all on a long rest.

features.name: Protective Field
features.description: Reaction to reduce damage to you or a creature within 30 feet by the die roll + Intelligence modifier.

features.name: Psionic Strike
features.description: Once per turn on a weapon hit, expend a die to deal extra force damage equal to the roll + Intelligence modifier.

features.name: Telekinetic Movement
features.description: Move an object or creature with your mind.

features.name: Telekinetic Adept (7th Level)
features.description: Gain additional psionic powers (e.g., Psi-Powered Leap, Telekinetic Thrust).

features.name: Guarded Mind (10th Level)
features.description: Resistance to psychic damage; can expend a die to end charmed or frightened.

features.name: Bulwark of Force (15th Level)
features.description: Grant cover to allies.

features.name: Telekinetic Master (18th Level)
features.description: Powerful capstone ability.

name: Rune Knight
flavor_text: "Using the ancient language of giants, you carve your will into the world. Runic magic heightens your strength, your durability, your very stature. Wield it and wreak havoc on your world’s evils."
description: A Fighter who inscribes giant runes onto equipment, gaining passive and active magical effects, and can grow in size.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies (3rd Level)
features.description: Learn to speak, read, and write Giant, and gain proficiency with smith's tools.

features.name: Rune Carver (3rd Level)
features.description: Inscribe magic runes onto objects, weapons, and armor, gaining passive bonuses and once-per-rest activated abilities.

features.name: Giant's Might (3rd Level)
features.description: As a bonus action, become Large for 1 minute. Gain advantage on Strength checks/saves, and once per turn deal extra damage. Uses equal to proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Runic Shield (7th Level)
features.description: Reaction to force an attacker to reroll a hit against an ally within 60 feet.

features.name: Great Stature (10th Level)
features.description: Giant's Might extra damage increases; you grow taller.

features.name: Master of Runes (15th Level)
features.description: Can invoke each rune twice per rest.

features.name: Runic Juggernaut (18th Level)
features.description: Giant's Might makes you Huge, increases damage and reach.

name: Samurai
flavor_text: (The Samurai is described as a "warrior poet" who is educated and cultured off the battlefield, while a downright determined Fighter on it.)
description: A disciplined Fighter who uses Fighting Spirit to gain advantage and temporary hit points, excels in social situations, and can delay death.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency (3rd Level)
features.description: Gain proficiency in History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion, or learn a language.

features.name: Fighting Spirit (3rd Level)
features.description: As a bonus action, gain advantage on all weapon attack rolls for the rest of the turn, and gain 5 temporary hit points. Uses: 3 per long rest (increases at higher levels).

features.name: Elegant Courtier (7th Level)
features.description: Add Wisdom modifier to Charisma (Persuasion) checks; gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.

features.name: Tireless Spirit (10th Level)
features.description: If you roll initiative and have no uses of Fighting Spirit remaining, regain one use.

features.name: Rapid Strike (15th Level)
features.description: When you have advantage on a weapon attack, you can forgo the advantage to make an additional weapon attack as a bonus action.

features.name: Strength Before Death (18th Level)
features.description: When damage would reduce you to 0 HP, you can delay that damage and immediately take a bonus turn. Once per long rest.

name: Way of the Open Hand
flavor_text: Monks of the Way of the Open Hand are the ultimate masters of martial arts combat, whether armed or unarmed. They learn techniques to push and trip their opponents, manipulate ki to heal damage to their bodies, and practice advanced meditation that can protect them from harm.
description: The archetypal “martial artist” monk. Open Hand monks use their mastery of ki to control the battlefield, debilitate enemies, and sustain themselves, culminating in the devastating Quivering Palm technique.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Open Hand Technique (3rd level)
features.description: Whenever you hit a creature with one of the attacks granted by your Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of three effects: knock the target prone (Dexterity save), push it up to 15 feet away (Strength save), or prevent it from taking reactions until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Wholeness of Body (6th level)
features.description: As an action, you can regain hit points equal to three times your monk level. You must finish a long rest before using this feature again.

features.name: Tranquility (11th level)
features.description: At the end of a long rest, you gain the effect of a sanctuary spell that lasts until the start of your next long rest (the saving throw DC equals your ki save DC). The effect ends early if you make an attack or cast a spell that affects a hostile creature.

features.name: Quivering Palm (17th level)
features.description: When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 3 ki points to start imperceptible vibrations in its body, lasting a number of days equal to your monk level. You can use your action to end the vibrations; the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it drops to 0 hit points; on a success, it takes 10d10 necrotic damage. You can have only one creature under this effect at a time.

name: Way of Shadow
flavor_text: Monks of the Way of Shadow follow a tradition that values stealth and subterfuge. These monks might be called ninjas or shadowdancers, and they serve as spies and assassins. Sometimes the members of a ninja monastery are family members, forming a clan sworn to secrecy about their arts and missions. Other monasteries are more like thieves’ guilds, hiring out their services to nobles, rich merchants, or anyone else who can pay their fees.
description: A stealth-focused monk who uses ki to manipulate darkness, teleport between shadows, and strike from concealment.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Shadow Arts (3rd level)
features.description: You can spend 2 ki points to cast one of the following spells: darkness, darkvision, pass without trace, silence, or minor illusion (as a bonus action). You also gain the minor illusion cantrip if you don’t already know it.

features.name: Shadow Step (6th level)
features.description: While in dim light or darkness, you can use a bonus action to teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness. You then have advantage on the first melee attack you make before the end of your turn.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows (11th level)
features.description: While in dim light or darkness, you can use your action to become invisible. You remain invisible until you make an attack, cast a spell, or are in an area of bright light.

features.name: Opportunist (17th level)
features.description: Whenever a creature is hit by an attack from a creature other than you, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature if it is within your reach.

name: Way of the Four Elements
flavor_text: You follow a monastic tradition that teaches you to harness the elements. When you focus your ki, you can align yourself with the forces of creation and bend the four elements to your will, using them as an extension of your body. Some members of this tradition dedicate themselves to a single element, but others weave the elements together. Many monks of this tradition tattoo their bodies with representations of their ki powers, commonly imagined as coiling dragons, but also as phoenixes, fish, plants, mountains, and cresting waves.
description: An elemental “half-caster” monk. You spend ki points to use Elemental Disciplines, which replicate spell effects with a wuxia flavor (e.g., burning hands becomes Sweeping Cinder Strike).
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Disciple of the Elements (3rd level)
features.description: You learn two Elemental Disciplines of your choice. You learn one additional discipline at 6th, 11th, and 17th level. Each discipline costs ki points to activate.

features.name: Elemental Disciplines (examples)
features.description: Sweeping Cinder Strike (burning hands), Fist of Four Thunders (thunderwave), Rush of the Gale Spirits (gust of wind), Shape the Flowing River (control water/ice), Water Whip (tendril of water that can pull or knock prone). Higher-level disciplines include Eternal Mountain Defense (stoneskin), Flames of the Phoenix (fireball), and River of Hungry Flame (wall of fire). Elemental Discipline Save DC = your ki save DC.

name: Way of the Long Death
flavor_text: Monks that are obsessed with the meaning and mechanics of death. They go as far as to capture creatures and do elaborate experiments to capture, record, and understand the moments of their demise. Then they use this knowledge to guide their understanding of martial arts, yielding a deadly fighting style. They are so involved with death that they have found a way to avoid it.
description: A macabre monk who studies death itself, gaining temporary vitality from fallen foes, spreading fear, and eventually learning to snuff out life with a touch.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Touch of Death (3rd level)
features.description: When you reduce a creature within 5 feet of you to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier + your monk level (minimum of 1).

features.name: Hour of Reaping (6th level)
features.description: As an action, each creature within 30 feet of you that can see you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Mastery of Death (11th level)
features.description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can expend 1 ki point (no action required) to have 1 hit point instead.

features.name: Touch of the Long Death (17th level)
features.description: As an action, you touch one creature within 5 feet and expend 1 to 10 ki points. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 necrotic damage per ki point spent on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

name: Way of the Sun Soul
flavor_text: Monks of the Way of the Sun Soul learn to channel their own life energy into searing bolts of light. They teach that meditation can unlock the ability to unleash the indomitable light shed by the soul of every living creature.
description: A ranged-damage monk. You transform your ki into radiant energy, gaining a ranged spell attack and area-of-effect bursts, eventually wreathed in a protective sun shield.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Radiant Sun Bolt (3rd level)
features.description: You gain a new attack option that you can use with the Attack action. It is a ranged spell attack (range 30 feet) that deals radiant damage equal to your Martial Arts die + your Dexterity modifier. When you use the Attack action, you can spend 1 ki point to make two Radiant Sun Bolt attacks as a bonus action.

features.name: Searing Arc Strike (6th level)
features.description: Immediately after you take the Attack action, you can spend 2 ki points to cast burning hands as a bonus action. You can spend additional ki points to cast it at a higher level (maximum equal to half your monk level, rounded down).

features.name: Searing Sunburst (11th level)
features.description: As an action, you can create an orb of light and hurl it at a point you choose within 150 feet. Each creature within 20 feet of that point must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d6 radiant damage on a failure. You can spend up to 3 ki points to increase the damage by 2d6 per ki point spent.

features.name: Sun Shield (17th level)
features.description: You can use a bonus action to wreath yourself in bright light (30-foot radius, plus 30 feet of dim light). While active, you can use your reaction to deal radiant damage equal to 5 + your Wisdom modifier to any creature that hits you with a melee attack.

name: Way of the Drunken Master
flavor_text: The Way of the Drunken Master teaches its students to move with the jerky, unpredictable movements of a drunkard. A drunken master sways, tottering on unsteady feet, to present what seems like an incompetent combatant who proves frustrating to engage. The drunken master’s erratic stumbles conceal a carefully executed dance of blocks, parries, advances, attacks, and retreats.
description: A mobility-and-luck monk. You stumble and sway through combat, using unpredictable movement to avoid attacks, redirect enemy strikes, and unleash a flurry of blows against multiple foes.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies (3rd level)
features.description: You gain proficiency in the Performance skill and with brewer’s supplies.

features.name: Drunken Technique (3rd level)
features.description: Whenever you use Flurry of Blows, you gain the benefit of the Disengage action, and your walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of the current turn.

features.name: Tipsy Sway (6th level)
features.description: You can spend 5 feet of movement (instead of half your speed) to stand up from prone. Additionally, when a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can spend 1 ki point as a reaction to redirect the attack to another creature within 5 feet of you (other than the attacker). Drunkard’s Luck (11th level): When you make an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw with disadvantage, you can spend 2 ki points to cancel the disadvantage for that roll.

features.name: Intoxicated Frenzy (17th level)
features.description: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can make up to three additional attacks (for a total of five Flurry attacks), provided each attack targets a different creature.

name: Way of the Kensei
flavor_text: Monks of the Way of the Kensei train relentlessly with their weapons, to the point that the weapon becomes like an extension of the body. This path also includes instruction in the deft strokes of calligraphy or painting. A kensei sees a weapon much in the same way a calligrapher or a painter regards a pen or brush.
description: A weapon-master monk. You select special kensei weapons and gain benefits that make them as effective as your unarmed strikes, blending melee and ranged combat with defensive parries.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Path of the Kensei (3rd level)
features.description: Choose two weapons to be your kensei weapons—one melee and one ranged—neither of which can have the heavy or special property. You gain proficiency with them, and they count as monk weapons for you. You can use Dexterity for attack and damage with them, and their damage die increases as your Martial Arts die increases. You also gain Agile Parry (when you make an unarmed strike while holding a melee kensei weapon, you gain +2 AC until the start of your next turn) and Kensei’s Shot (bonus action: add 1d4 damage to your next ranged kensei weapon attack). You also gain proficiency with calligrapher’s supplies or painter’s supplies.

features.name: One with the Blade (6th level)
features.description: Your kensei weapons count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance. You gain Deft Strike: once per turn, when you hit with a kensei weapon, you can spend 1 ki point to deal extra damage equal to your Martial Arts die.

features.name: Sharpen the Blade (11th level)
features.description: As a bonus action, you can spend up to 3 ki points to grant a kensei weapon a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of ki points spent. This lasts for 1 minute or until you use this feature again.

features.name: Unerring Accuracy (17th level)
features.description: If you miss with an attack roll using a kensei weapon, you can reroll it. You can use this feature only once on each of your turns.

name: Way of the Cobalt Soul
flavor_text: Driven by the pursuit of knowledge and its scholars’ worship of the Knowing Mentor, the Library of the Cobalt Soul is one of the best-respected and most heavily guarded repositories of tomes, history, and information in all Exandria. The monks of the Cobalt Soul are the embodiment of the maxim: “Know your enemy.” Through tireless research, they steel themselves against the unrelenting tides of evil. Through rigorous training, they learn to break through their foes’ mental and physical defenses. Then, once the fight is done, they record their findings for future generations of monks to study.
description: An investigative, anti-mage monk. You analyze enemies to discover their weaknesses, force truth from liars, and eventually learn to debilitate foes with precise strikes.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material (this is partnered Critical Role content).

features.name: Extract Aspects (3rd level)
features.description: When you hit a creature with an attack from Flurry of Blows, you can analyze it. You learn its damage vulnerabilities, resistances, immunities, and condition immunities. While analyzed, whenever that creature misses you with an attack, you can use your reaction to make an unarmed strike against it if it is within reach. The analysis lasts until you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Extort Truth (6th level)
features.description: When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 1 ki point to force it to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it cannot speak a deliberate lie for up to 10 minutes, and Charisma checks against it have advantage. You can also choose to touch it without dealing damage to use this effect.

features.name: Mystical Erudition (6th level)
features.description: You learn one language and gain proficiency in one of the following skills: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, or Religion. If already proficient, you can double your proficiency bonus for one of those skills. You gain an additional language and skill at 11th and 17th level.

features.name: Mind of Mercury (11th level)
features.description: You can take two reactions per round, but only one per turn. You can also use your reaction to make an opportunity attack without using your reaction.

features.name: Debilitating Barrage (17th level)
features.description: When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 3 ki points to debilitate it. The target must make a Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws until the end of your next turn.

name: Way of Mercy
flavor_text: Monks of the Way of Mercy learn to manipulate the life force of others to bring aid to those in need. They are wandering physicians, bringing succor to the wounded and mercy to the wicked.
description: A healing-and-harm monk. You balance restorative ki with necrotic strikes, acting as a mobile combat medic who can both mend allies and execute foes.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Implements of Mercy (3rd level)
features.description: You gain proficiency in the Insight and Medicine skills and with the herbalism kit. You also receive a special mask (cosmetic).

features.name: Hand of Healing (3rd level)
features.description: As an action, you can spend 1 ki point to touch a creature and restore hit points equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier. You can replace one unarmed strike in Flurry of Blows with this healing without spending the ki point.

features.name: Hand of Harm (3rd level)
features.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 1 ki point to deal extra necrotic damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier. Physician’s Touch (6th level): Your Hand of Healing can also end one disease or one of the following conditions: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned, or stunned. Your Hand of Harm can also poison the target until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm (11th level)
features.description: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace one unarmed strike with a use of Hand of Healing without spending ki. You can also use Hand of Harm on one of the Flurry attacks without spending ki (still once per turn).

features.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy (17th level)
features.description: As an action, you can spend 5 ki points to touch a creature that has died within the past 24 hours and return it to life with 4d10 + your Wisdom modifier hit points. You also end the blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned, and stunned conditions on it.

name: Way of the Astral Self
flavor_text: A monk who follows the Way of the Astral Self believes that their body is an illusion. They learn to project their true self—a spectral manifestation of their ki—to strike down their foes and protect their allies.
description: A spectral-summoner monk. You manifest astral arms, a visage, and a body, each granting unique offensive, defensive, and utility benefits. The subclass reduces reliance on Dexterity by allowing Wisdom to replace Strength and Dexterity for many monk abilities.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Arms of the Astral Self (3rd level)
features.description: As a bonus action, you can spend 1 ki point to summon spectral arms for 10 minutes. While active, you can use your Wisdom modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for unarmed strikes and Strength checks/saves. Your unarmed strikes can deal force damage, and you can make an additional unarmed strike as part of the Attack action (once per turn). The arms have a reach of 5 feet.

features.name: Visage of the Astral Self (6th level)
features.description: As a bonus action, you can spend 1 ki point to summon a spectral mask for 10 minutes. You gain darkvision (120 feet), can see in magical darkness, and have advantage on Insight and Intimidation checks. You can also speak telepathically to creatures within 60 feet.

features.name: Body of the Astral Self (11th level)
features.description: While both arms and visage are active, you can summon a spectral body (no action required). You gain resistance to one damage type of your choice (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison), and your astral arms deal extra damage equal to your Martial Arts die.

features.name: Awakened Astral Self (17th level)
features.description: As a bonus action, you can spend 5 ki points to summon all three aspects simultaneously for 10 minutes. You gain +2 AC, and you can make three attacks with your astral arms when you take the Attack action (instead of two).

name: Way of the Ascendant Dragon
flavor_text: Legend says that when the dragon god Bahamut first traveled to the Material Plane, he did so in the guise of a young monk. In his journeys, he founded the Way of the Ascendant Dragon so that other monks could better connect with the world and its magic. The subclass allows you to dance like a dragon on the winds and to strike with the fury of their breath attacks.
description: A draconic monk. You emulate dragonkind, changing your damage type, exhaling destructive breath, unfurling spectral wings, and projecting an aura of draconic fear.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Draconic Disciple (3rd level)
features.description: You learn Draconic (or another language). You can reroll a failed Charisma (Intimidation) or Charisma (Persuasion) check (once per long rest). When you deal damage with an unarmed strike, you can change the damage type to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.

features.name: Breath of the Dragon (3rd level)
features.description: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one attack with a breath weapon: a 20-foot cone or a 30-foot line (5 feet wide). Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. Creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw against your ki save DC, taking damage equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die (half on a success). You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you can spend 2 ki points to use it again when out of uses.

features.name: Wings Unfurled (6th level)
features.description: As a bonus action, you can unfurl spectral dragon wings for 10 minutes. You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can use this once per long rest, or spend 3 ki points to use it again.

features.name: Aspect of the Wyrm (11th level)
features.description: As a bonus action, you can project an aura of draconic fear for 1 minute (10-foot radius). When you create the aura, and as a bonus action on subsequent turns, you can choose one creature in the aura; it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the start of your next turn. You can also choose to emanate an aura of elemental energy instead, granting you and allies resistance to one damage type.

features.name: Ascendant Aspect (17th level)
features.description: You gain blindsight out to 10 feet. Your Breath of the Dragon damage increases to three rolls of your Martial Arts die. Your Wings Unfurled duration increases to 1 hour. You can use Aspect of the Wyrm without expending a use.

name: Oath of Devotion
flavor_text: "The Oath of Devotion binds a paladin to the loftiest ideals of justice, virtue, and order. Sometimes called cavaliers, white knights, or holy warriors, these paladins meet the ideal of the knight in shining armor, acting with honor in pursuit of justice and the greater good."
description: The archetypal "knight in shining armor" Paladin. Devotion Paladins uphold a strict code of honesty, courage, compassion, honor, and duty. They are incorruptible defenders of the weak and relentless foes of fiends and undead.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Sacred Weapon (3rd level): As an action, imbue a weapon with positive energy for 1 minute. You add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls with it (minimum +1), and it emits bright light (20 ft.) and dim light (20 ft. beyond). It becomes magical if it wasn't already.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Turn the Unholy (3rd level): As an action, present your holy symbol. Each fiend or undead within 30 feet that can see or hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw or be turned for 1 minute.

features.name: Aura of Devotion (7th level)
features.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be charmed while you are conscious. At 18th level, the range increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Purity of Spirit (15th level)
features.description: You are always under the effects of a protection from evil and good spell.

features.name: Holy Nimbus (20th level)
features.description: As an action, emanate an aura of sunlight for 1 minute. Bright light shines from you in a 30-foot radius. Whenever an enemy starts its turn in the bright light, it takes 10 radiant damage. You also have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by fiends or undead.

name: Oath of the Ancients
flavor_text: "The Oath of the Ancients is as old as the first elves. Paladins who swear this oath cherish the light; they love the beautiful and life-giving things of the world more than any principles of honor, courage, and justice. They often adorn their armor and clothing with images of growing things—leaves, antlers, or flowers—to reflect their commitment to preserving life and light."
description: A nature-loving Paladin who acts as a guardian of life and light. Ancients Paladins are often fey-touched or sworn to gods of nature, and they excel at protecting allies from magic.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Nature's Wrath (3rd level): As an action, conjure spectral vines around creatures of your choice within 15 feet. Each must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained for 1 minute (repeating the save at the end of each turn).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Turn the Faithless (3rd level): As an action, each fey or fiend within 30 feet that can see or hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw or be turned for 1 minute.

features.name: Aura of Warding (7th level)
features.description: Ancient magic forms an eldritch ward. You and allies within 10 feet have resistance to damage from spells. At 18th level, the range increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Undying Sentinel (15th level)
features.description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points and aren't killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You also suffer none of the drawbacks of old age.

features.name: Elder Champion (20th level)
features.description: As a bonus action, imbue your Aura of Protection with primal power for 1 minute. You regain 10 hit points at the start of each turn, cast paladin spells with a 1-action casting time as a bonus action, and enemy creatures within 10 feet have disadvantage on saving throws against your spells and Channel Divinity options.

name: Oath of Vengeance
flavor_text: "The Oath of Vengeance is a solemn commitment to punish those who have committed grievously evil acts. When evil armies slaughter helpless villagers, when a tyrant defies the will of the gods, when a thieves' guild grows too violent, when a dragon rampages through the countryside—at times like these, paladins arise and swear an Oath of Vengeance to set right what has gone wrong."
description: A relentless avenger who fights injustice by any means necessary. Vengeance Paladins are often grim and focused, willing to sacrifice their own purity to punish the wicked.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Abjure Enemy (3rd level): As an action, choose one creature within 60 feet. It must make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute (speed reduced to 0 while frightened). Fiends and undead have disadvantage on this save.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Vow of Enmity (3rd level): As a bonus action, utter a vow against a creature within 10 feet. You gain advantage on attack rolls against it for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 HP.

features.name: Relentless Avenger (7th level)
features.description: When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, you can move up to half your speed immediately after the attack as part of the same reaction. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance (15th level)
features.description: When a creature under your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it if it is within range.

features.name: Avenging Angel (20th level)
features.description: As an action, assume an angelic form for 1 hour. You gain a flying speed of 60 feet and emanate an aura of menace (30-foot radius). The first time an enemy enters the aura or starts its turn there, it must make a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for 1 minute.

name: Oath of Glory
flavor_text: "Paladins who take the Oath of Glory believe they and their companions are destined to achieve glory through deeds of heroism. They train diligently and encourage their companions, so they're all ready when destiny calls."
description: A heroic Paladin who seeks legendary deeds and inspires others to greatness. Glory Paladins are athletes, champions, and leaders who thrive in the spotlight.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Inspiring Smite (3rd level): Immediately after you cast Divine Smite, you can expend a use of Channel Divinity to distribute temporary hit points to creatures of your choice within 30 feet (including you). The total temporary HP equals 2d8 + your Paladin level, divided as you like.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Peerless Athlete (3rd level): As a bonus action, augment your athleticism for 1 hour. You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and your long jump distance increases.

features.name: Aura of Alacrity (7th level)
features.description: You emanate an aura of speed. Your walking speed increases by 10 feet. Allies who start their turn within 5 feet of you gain a 10-foot bonus to their walking speed until the end of their turn.

features.name: Glorious Defense (15th level)
features.description: When a creature hits you or an ally within 10 feet with an attack, you can use your reaction to grant a bonus to AC equal to your Charisma modifier, potentially causing the attack to miss. If the attack misses, you can make a weapon attack against the attacker.

features.name: Living Legend (20th level)
features.description: As a bonus action, assume a legendary form for 1 minute. You gain advantage on all Charisma checks, and once per turn when you miss with a weapon attack, you can choose to hit instead. You can also turn a failed saving throw into a success (once per use of this feature).

name: Oathbreaker
flavor_text: "An Oathbreaker is a paladin who has broken their sacred oath. They are often villains, but some are tragic figures who broke their oath for what they believed was a greater good. Whatever the reason, they are forever changed, wielding dark powers that other paladins shun."
description: A fallen Paladin who has forsaken their oath. Oathbreakers command undead, project an aura of hate, and use fear to achieve their goals.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material. The Oathbreaker is typically an NPC subclass, but it can be used by players with DM permission.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Spiteful Suffering (3rd level): As an action, choose one creature within 30 feet. It must make a Charisma saving throw or take 1d4 + your Charisma modifier necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns for 1 minute.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Dreadful Aspect (3rd level): As an action, each creature within 30 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you for 1 minute.

features.name: Aura of Hate (7th level)
features.description: You and any fiends or undead within 10 feet of you gain a bonus to melee weapon damage rolls equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1).

features.name: Supernatural Resistance (15th level)
features.description: You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.

features.name: Dread Lord (20th level)
features.description: As an action, you can control undead more effectively. You can use a bonus action to command any undead you have created or control, and you gain resistance to necrotic damage.

name: Oath of the Crown
flavor_text: "The Oath of the Crown is sworn to the ideals of civilization, be it the spirit of a nation, fealty to a sovereign, or service to a deity of law and rulership. The paladins who swear this oath dedicate themselves to serving society and, in particular, the just laws that hold society together."
description: A Paladin sworn to uphold law, loyalty, and order. Crown Paladins are the guardians of civilization, willing to sacrifice themselves to protect their allies and their society.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Champion Challenge (3rd level): As a bonus action, issue a challenge. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw or be unable to willingly move more than 30 feet away from you for 1 minute.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Turn the Tide (3rd level): As a bonus action, each creature of your choice within 30 feet that can hear you regains hit points equal to 1d6 + your Paladin level if it is below half its hit point maximum.

features.name: Divine Allegiance (7th level)
features.description: When a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to magically substitute your own health for theirs. The creature takes no damage, and you take the damage instead (this damage cannot be reduced or prevented).

features.name: Unyielding Saint (15th level)
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws to avoid becoming paralyzed or stunned.

features.name: Exalted Champion (20th level)
features.description: As an action, gain the following benefits for 1 hour: resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; allies within 30 feet have advantage on death saving throws; you and allies within 30 feet have advantage on Wisdom saving throws. Once used, you must finish a long rest before using it again.

name: Oath of Conquest
flavor_text: "The Oath of Conquest calls to paladins who seek glory in battle and the subjugation of their enemies. It isn't enough for these paladins to establish order. They must crush the forces of chaos. Sometimes called knight tyrants or iron mongers, those who swear this oath gather into grim orders that serve gods or philosophies of war and well-ordered might."
description: A fearsome Paladin who seeks to dominate and subjugate. Conquest Paladins use fear as a weapon, crushing their enemies and imposing order through overwhelming might.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Conquering Presence (3rd level): As an action, force each creature of your choice within 30 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is frightened of you for 1 minute (repeating the save at the end of each turn).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Guided Strike (3rd level): When you make an attack roll, you can use your Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll. You can choose to do so after seeing the roll but before the DM declares success or failure.

features.name: Aura of Conquest (7th level)
features.description: If a creature is frightened of you, its speed is reduced to 0 while in your aura (10 feet), and it takes psychic damage equal to half your Paladin level if it starts its turn there. At 18th level, the aura's range increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Scornful Rebuke (15th level)
features.description: When a creature hits you with an attack, it takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1).

features.name: Invincible Conqueror (20th level)
features.description: As an action, gain resistance to all damage for 1 minute. You can also make one additional attack when you take the Attack action, and your critical hit range increases to 19–20.

name: Oath of Redemption
flavor_text: "The Oath of Redemption holds a paladin to a high standard of peace and justice. Paladins who swear this oath believe that any creature can be redeemed, and they seek to resolve conflicts without violence whenever possible. They are patient, wise, and compassionate, but they are not naïve—they know that some evils must be stopped by force."
description: A pacifistic Paladin who seeks to redeem evildoers and resolve conflicts peacefully. Redemption Paladins are defensive and supportive, protecting allies and deflecting violence.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Armor of Peace (3rd level)
features.description: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a shield, your AC equals 16 + your Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Warrior of Reconciliation (3rd level)
features.description: When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a simple bludgeoning weapon, you can choose to spare its life. Instead of falling unconscious, it is charmed by you for 1 minute and is peaceful and docile.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Emissary of Peace (3rd level): As a bonus action, gain a +5 bonus to the next Charisma (Persuasion) check you make within the next minute.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Rebuke the Violent (3rd level): As a reaction when an enemy within 10 feet deals damage to a creature other than you, force it to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes radiant damage equal to the damage it just dealt (half on a success).

features.name: Aura of the Guardian (7th level)
features.description: When an ally within 10 feet takes damage, you can use your reaction to magically take that damage instead.

features.name: Protective Spirit (15th level)
features.description: At the end of each turn in combat, if you have fewer than half your hit points remaining, you regain hit points equal to 1d6 + half your Paladin level.

features.name: Emissary of Redemption (20th level)
features.description: You gain resistance to all damage dealt by other creatures. Additionally, when a creature hits you with an attack, it takes radiant damage equal to half the damage it dealt to you. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

name: Oath of the Watchers
flavor_text: "Paladins who follow the Watchers' oath are ever vigilant in spotting the influence of extraplanar forces, often establishing a network of spies and informants to gather information on suspected cults. To a Watcher, keeping a healthy suspicion and awareness about one's surroundings is as natural as wearing armor in battle."
description: A vigilant Paladin sworn to defend the mortal realms from extraplanar threats. Watchers are suspicious, disciplined, and well-prepared for aberrations, fiends, and otherworldly horrors.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Watcher's Will (3rd level): As an action, choose up to your Charisma modifier creatures within 30 feet. For 1 minute, you and the chosen creatures have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Abjure the Extraplanar (3rd level): As an action, each aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend within 30 feet that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw or be turned for 1 minute.

features.name: Aura of the Sentinel (7th level)
features.description: You emit an aura of alertness while you aren't incapacitated. When you and creatures of your choice within 10 feet roll initiative, you all gain a bonus to initiative equal to your proficiency bonus. At 18th level, the range increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Vigilant Rebuke (15th level)
features.description: Whenever you or a creature you can see within 30 feet succeeds on an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, you can use your reaction to deal 2d8 + your Charisma modifier force damage to the creature that forced the save.

features.name: Mortal Bulwark (20th level)
features.description: As a bonus action, gain the following benefits for 1 minute: truesight out to 120 feet, advantage on attack rolls against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, and fiends, and you can use your reaction to force a creature that hits you with an attack to make a Charisma saving throw or be banished to its native plane.

name: Hunter
flavor_text: "You stalk prey in the wilds and elsewhere, using your abilities as a Hunter to protect nature and people everywhere from forces that would destroy them."
description: The Hunter is the archetypal Ranger, a versatile and deadly warrior who excels at fighting a wide variety of threats. You learn specialized techniques to take down formidable foes, cleave through hordes of enemies, and defend yourself against the tactics of both beasts and intelligent creatures.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Hunter's Lore (3rd Level)
features.description: You can call on the forces of nature to reveal the strengths and weaknesses of your prey. While a creature is marked by your Hunter's Mark, you know if it has any damage immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities and what they are.

features.name: Hunter's Prey (3rd Level)
features.description: You choose one of two specialized tactics, which you can change on a short or long rest.

features.name: Colossus Slayer
features.description: Your tenacity wears down even the most resilient foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon, it deals an extra 1d8 damage if it's missing any hit points. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

features.name: Horde Breaker
features.description: Once on each of your turns when you make a weapon attack, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature within 5 feet of the original target.

features.name: Defensive Tactics (7th Level)
features.description: You choose one of two defensive options, which you can change on a short or long rest.

features.name: Escape the Horde
features.description: Opportunity attacks have disadvantage against you.

features.name: Multiattack Defense
features.description: When a creature hits you with an attack, it has disadvantage on all other attack rolls against you for the rest of that turn.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Prey (11th Level)
features.description: Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature marked by your Hunter's Mark, you can also deal that spell's extra damage to a different creature you can see within 30 feet of the first creature.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense (15th Level)
features.description: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to gain resistance to that damage and any other damage of the same type until the end of the current turn.

name: Beast Master
flavor_text: "A Beast Master forms a mystical bond with a special animal, drawing on primal magic and a deep connection to the natural world."
description: You are a Ranger who has formed a powerful, supernatural bond with a primal beast. This creature fights alongside you as a trusted companion, and your connection allows you to draw on its strength and enhance its abilities as you both grow in power.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Primal Companion (3rd Level)
features.description: You magically summon a primal beast that draws strength from your bond with nature. You choose its stat block (e.g., Beast of the Land, Sea, or Sky). It is friendly to you and your allies and obeys your commands. In combat, it acts on your turn; you can command it to take an action as a bonus action or sacrifice one of your attacks to command it to make a Beast's Strike.

features.name: Exceptional Training (7th Level)
features.description: You can use a bonus action to command your beast companion to take the Dash, Disengage, or Help action on its turn.

features.name: Bestial Fury (11th Level)
features.description: Your beast companion can make two attacks when you command it to take the Attack action, or it can take the Multiattack action if it has that action.

features.name: Share Spells (15th Level)
features.description: When you cast a spell targeting yourself, you can also affect your beast companion with the spell if the beast is within 30 feet of you.

name: Gloom Stalker
flavor_text: "Gloom Stalkers are at home in the darkest places, wielding magic drawn from the Shadowfell to combat enemies that lurk in darkness."
description: A master of ambush and subterfuge, the Gloom Stalker is a Ranger who has adapted to the lightless depths of the world. You use the power of shadow to become an unseen terror, striking from darkness and using fear and psychic magic to disorient and destroy your foes.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Dread Ambusher (3rd Level)
features.description: You have mastered the art of creating fearsome ambushes. You gain the following benefits:

features.name: Ambusher's Leap
features.description: At the start of your first turn of each combat, your speed increases by 10 feet until the end of that turn.

features.name: Dreadful Strike
features.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 2d6 psychic damage. You can use this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

features.name: Initiative Bonus
features.description: You can add your Wisdom modifier to your initiative rolls.

features.name: Umbral Sight (3rd Level)
features.description: You gain darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have darkvision, its range increases by 60 feet. While entirely in darkness, you are invisible to any creature that relies on darkvision to see you in that darkness.

features.name: Iron Mind (7th Level)
features.description: You have honed your ability to resist mind-altering powers. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.

features.name: Stalker's Flurry (11th Level)
features.description: You learn to attack with such astonishing swiftness that you can turn a miss into another strike. Once per turn when you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another weapon attack as part of the same action.

features.name: Shadowy Dodge (15th Level)
features.description: You can instantly vanish into the shadows in response to an attack. When a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on that roll, provided you are in dim light or darkness.

name: Horizon Walker
flavor_text: "Horizon walkers guard the world against threats that originate from other planes or that seek to ravage the mortal realm with otherworldly magic."
description: You are a sentinel of the multiverse, a Ranger tasked with guarding the boundaries between planes. You draw upon the energy of the cosmos to empower your attacks with force, to step through space in the blink of an eye, and to defend reality itself from extraplanar threats.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Detect Portal (3rd Level)
features.description: You gain the ability to sense the presence of planar portals. As an action, you can detect the distance and direction to the closest planar portal within 1 mile of you. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses on a long rest.

features.name: Planar Warrior (3rd Level)
features.description: You learn to draw on the energy of the multiverse to augment your attacks. As a bonus action, you can focus planar energy on your weapon. The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack this turn, all damage from the attack becomes force damage, and it deals an extra 1d8 force damage. This extra damage increases to 2d8 at 11th level.

features.name: Ethereal Step (7th Level)
features.description: You can cast the Etherealness spell, but only on yourself. You can use this feature once per short or long rest.

features.name: Distant Strike (11th Level)
features.description: You gain the ability to pass between the planes in a blink of an eye. When you take the Attack action, you can teleport up to 10 feet before each attack to an unoccupied space you can see. If you attack at least two different creatures with the action, you can make a third attack against a third creature.

features.name: Spectral Defense (15th Level)
features.description: When you take damage from an attack, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to all of that attack's damage until the end of the current turn.

name: Monster Slayer
flavor_text: "You have dedicated yourself to hunting down creatures of the night and wielders of grim magic. A monster slayer seeks out vampires, dragons, evil fey, fiends, and other magical threats."
description: A grim and determined hunter of the supernatural, you are an expert in identifying and exploiting the weaknesses of magical monsters. You use ancient techniques to resist their powers, thwart their spells, and deliver a final, decisive counterstrike against your chosen prey.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Hunter's Sense (3rd Level)
features.description: As an action, you can choose one creature you can see within 60 feet and learn whether it has any damage immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities and what they are. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

features.name: Slayer's Prey (3rd Level)
features.description: As a bonus action, you can designate one creature you can see within 60 feet as your prey. The first time each turn that you hit that target with a weapon attack, it takes an extra 1d6 damage from the weapon. This benefit lasts until you finish a short or long rest or designate a different creature.

features.name: Supernatural Defense (7th Level)
features.description: Whenever the target of your Slayer's Prey forces you to make a saving throw, or when you make an ability check to escape its grapple, you can add 1d6 to your roll.

features.name: Magic-User's Nemesis (11th Level)
features.description: When you see a creature casting a spell or teleporting within 60 feet of you, you can use your reaction to try to foil it. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC, or its spell or teleportation fails. You can use this feature once per short or long rest.

features.name: Slayer's Counter (15th Level)
features.description: If the target of your Slayer's Prey forces you to make a saving throw, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack against it. If this attack hits, your saving throw automatically succeeds, in addition to the attack's normal effects.

name: Fey Wanderer
flavor_text: "A fey mystique surrounds you, thanks to the boon of an archfey or a location in the Feywild that transformed you. However you gained fey magic, you are now a Fey Wanderer. Your joyful laughter brightens the hearts of the downtrodden, and your martial prowess strikes terror in your foes, for great is the mirth of the fey and dreadful is their fury."
description: You are a Ranger touched by the magic of the Feywild. Your presence is both charming and terrifying, allowing you to beguile and deceive others while your weapon strikes carry the psychic trauma of the fey. You are a master of both social grace and mental warfare.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Dreadful Strikes (3rd Level)
features.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra 1d4 psychic damage to the target, which can take this extra damage only once per turn. This extra damage increases to 1d6 at 11th level.

features.name: Otherworldly Glamour (3rd Level)
