Choose one of the following effects: Major Transformation (transmute a nonmagical object), Panacea (remove all curses, diseases, and poisons and restore all hit points), Restore Life (cast Raise Dead without a spell slot), or Restore Youth (reduce your apparent age by 3d10 years).

name: War Magic
flavor_text: A War Mage fuses facets of Invocation and Abjuration through long study and practice in combat. Like a warrior with sword and shield, a War Mage wields equal might through their arcane mastery.
description: The battlefield tactician. War Mages are resilient and swift, using Arcane Deflection to shrug off blows and bolster their saves, adding their Intelligence to initiative, and eventually punishing attackers with a deflecting shroud.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Arcane Deflection (2nd Level)
features.description: When you are hit by an attack or fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain a +2 bonus to AC against that attack or a +4 bonus to the saving throw. You can't cast spells other than cantrips until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Tactical Wit (2nd Level)
features.description: You can add your Intelligence modifier to your initiative rolls.

features.name: Power Surge (6th Level)
features.description: You can store magical energy within yourself to later empower your damaging spells. You can store a maximum number of power surges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one). When you cast a wizard spell that deals damage, you can spend one power surge to deal extra force damage to one target equal to half your wizard level.

features.name: Durable Magic (10th Level)
features.description: While you maintain concentration on a spell, you have a +2 bonus to AC and all saving throws.

features.name: Deflecting Shroud (14th Level)
features.description: When you use your Arcane Deflection, you can deal force damage to up to three creatures of your choice within 60 feet of you, equal to half your wizard level.

name: Bladesinging
flavor_text: Bladesingers are wizards who weave together swordplay and dance with their magic. They are masters of a secret elven magic called the Bladesong, which allows them to incorporate swordplay and dance along with wizardry.
description: The gish wizard. Bladesingers enter a state called the Bladesong, gaining increased speed, AC, and concentration, allowing them to thrive in melee combat while still casting powerful spells.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Training in War and Song (2nd Level)
features.description: You gain proficiency with light armor and one type of one-handed melee weapon of your choice. You also gain proficiency in the Performance skill.

features.name: Bladesong (2nd Level)
features.description: As a bonus action, you can invoke the Bladesong for 1 minute, provided you aren't wearing medium or heavy armor or using a shield. It ends early if you are incapacitated, don medium or heavy armor or a shield, or use two hands to make a weapon attack. While active, you gain a bonus to AC equal to your Intelligence modifier, your walking speed increases by 10 feet, you have advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and you gain a bonus to concentration saves equal to your Intelligence modifier.

features.name: Extra Attack (6th Level)
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Song of Defense (10th Level)
features.description: When you take damage while Bladesong is active, you can use your reaction to expend one spell slot and reduce that damage by an amount equal to five times the spell slot's level.

features.name: Song of Victory (14th Level)
features.description: While your Bladesong is active, you add your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1) to the damage of your melee weapon attacks.

name: Order of Scribes
flavor_text: Among wizards, the Order of Scribes is the most bookish. And while all wizards value spellbooks, a wizard in the Order of Scribes magically awakens their book, turning it into a trusted companion. All wizards study books, but a wizardly scribe talks to theirs.
description: The master of the spellbook. Scribes wizards use a magical quill to copy spells with incredible speed and can awaken their spellbook to act as a spectral assistant, eventually gaining the ability to cast spells from its pages.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Wizardly Quill (2nd Level)
features.description: As a bonus action, you can magically create a Tiny quill in your free hand. The quill can copy spells into your spellbook in 2 minutes per spell level if you have the spell prepared, and it can erase ink at a touch.

features.name: Awakened Spellbook (2nd Level)
features.description: You can use your spellbook as a spellcasting focus. While holding it, you can cast wizard spells with a casting time of 1 action as a ritual if they have the ritual tag. You can also use the book to cast a spell that you don't have prepared by expending a spell slot and a number of minutes equal to the spell's level.

features.name: Master Scrivener (6th Level)
features.description: You can create a magical scroll faster than normal, and you can create scrolls of spells you don't have prepared.

features.name: Manifest Mind (10th Level)
features.description: You can cause your spellbook to manifest a spectral mind that can float and act as a scout. You can cast spells as if you were in the mind's space.

features.name: One with the Word (14th Level)
features.description: You can draw on your spellbook's magic to protect yourself, sacrificing its pages to absorb damage.

name: Chronurgy Magic
flavor_text: Focusing on the manipulation of time, those who follow the Chronurgy tradition learn to alter the pace of reality to their liking. Wizards who practice this tradition are sometimes called chronurgists.
description: The time manipulator. Chronurgists can force rerolls, add their Intelligence modifier to initiative, and eventually freeze a spell in a mote of temporal energy to be used later. They bend the flow of time to control the battlefield.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Chronal Shift (2nd Level)
features.description: When you or a creature within 30 feet makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to force a reroll of the d20. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses on a long rest.

features.name: Temporal Awareness (2nd Level)
features.description: You can add your Intelligence modifier to your initiative rolls.

features.name: Momentary Stasis (6th Level)
features.description: As an action, you can force a Large or smaller creature within 60 feet to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is encased in a field of temporal energy, incapacitated and with a speed of 0, until the end of your next turn or until it takes damage.

features.name: Arcane Abeyance (10th Level)
features.description: When you cast a spell using a spell slot of 4th level or lower, you can condense the spell's magic into a mote. A creature holding the mote can use its action to cast the spell.

features.name: Convergent Future (14th Level)
features.description: When you or a creature you can see within 60 feet makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to ignore the die roll and decide whether the number rolled is the minimum needed to succeed or one less than that number. You gain one level of exhaustion, which can't be removed by a long rest.

name: Graviturgy Magic
flavor_text: Understanding and mastering the forces that draw bodies of matter together or drive them apart, the students of the Graviturgy tradition learn to manipulate the violent energy of gravity to their benefit.
description: The gravity manipulator. Graviturgists can alter the weight of objects and creatures, adjust density to make attacks hit harder or softer, and eventually create a gravity well that pulls enemies toward a central point.
dm_guidelines: Not present in official source material.

features.name: Adjust Density (2nd Level)
features.description: As an action, you can magically alter the weight of one object or creature you can see within 30 feet. The target's weight is halved or doubled, which can affect its carrying capacity, jumping distance, and the damage it takes from falling.

features.name: Gravity Well (6th Level)
features.description: You've learned how to manipulate gravity around a living being. When you cast a spell on a creature, you can create a gravity well centered on it until the end of your next turn. The creature has disadvantage on Strength saving throws and can pull other creatures toward it.

features.name: Violent Attraction (10th Level)
features.description: When you or a creature within 30 feet hits with a weapon attack, you can use your reaction to increase the damage by 1d10. You can do this a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier per long rest.

features.name: Event Horizon (14th Level)
features.description: As an action, you can emanate a powerful gravitational field for 1 minute (concentration). Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it takes 8d10 force damage and its speed is reduced to 0 until the start of your next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and is not slowed.

name: Lore Mastery
flavor_text: Lore Mastery is an arcane tradition fixated on understanding the underlying mechanics of magic. Known as savants, its students seek to unravel the mysteries of magic and master its application.
description: The metamagic wizard (Unearthed Arcana playtest material). Lore Masters can change the damage type of their spells, alter saving throws, and eventually cast a spell from any class's list, making them incredibly versatile.
dm_guidelines: This subclass originated in Unearthed Arcana (UA) and is not official published material. It is presented as playtest/homebrew content.

features.name: Lore Master (2nd Level)
features.description: You become a compendium of knowledge. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion if you are proficient in that skill. Additionally, you can use your Intelligence modifier instead of your Dexterity modifier for initiative rolls.

features.name: Spell Secrets (2nd Level)
features.description: When you cast a spell with a spell slot, you can change its damage type to another type from a specific list (acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder). You can do this a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier per long rest.

features.name: Alchemical Casting (6th Level)
features.description: When you cast a spell, you can expend a spell slot to increase its power. You can spend a 1st-level slot to increase the spell's damage by 2d10 force damage, a 2nd-level slot to increase its range, or a 3rd-level slot to increase its saving throw DC by 2.

features.name: Prodigious Memory (10th Level)
features.description: You can replace one of your prepared wizard spells with another spell from your spellbook as an action.

features.name: Master of Magic (14th Level)
features.description: As a bonus action, you can call to mind the ability to cast one spell of your choice from any class's spell list. The spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots, and you mustn't have it prepared. If the spell isn't a wizard spell, it counts as a wizard spell when you cast it. The ability to cast the spell vanishes when you cast it or when the current turn ends.
